in_marathi.name: Divija

in_marathi.long_meaning: Divija हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Divija is a Sanskrit and Hindi name meaning 'Divine Goddess' or 'Shining One'. This name is often given to girls born during auspicious occasions, as it is believed to bring blessings and good fortune.
